website.faq.sections.smart-app-control.b:
Windows 11 Smart App Control can block Firestone's memory-reader file (OverwolfUnitySpy.dll). When that happens:

  • You're not seeing widgets in-game
  • Restarting Firestone or Hearthstone does not help
  • The Firestone main window (collection, stats) can still work

To check whether Smart App Control is on: open Windows Security → App & browser control → Smart App Control settings. See Microsoft's Smart App Control FAQ.

Update to the latest Firestone. Recent releases sign the memory-reader plugin so Windows can allow it. If you are already on the latest version and overlays are still empty, please report a bug from the app.
